nodes.name: Every 5 Minutes
nodes.notes: Every 5 minutes, 24/7 - so overnight downtime is now visible. For the old business-hours-only behaviour use '*/5 7-18 * * *'.

nodes.name: Get Devices1
nodes.notes: Still fetches the full device list; the SD-GEN072 filter happens in Normalise. Once you know the numeric RMS id for SD-GEN072 you can change the URL to https://rms.teltonika-networks.com/api/devices/<id> and drop pagination entirely - worth doing at a 5-minute cadence.

nodes.name: Normalise1
nodes.notes: Filters to SD-GEN072 by name and throws if it isn't found, so a rename in RMS shows up as a failed execution rather than an empty table.

nodes.name: BigQuery Insert2
nodes.notes: Append-only. Key (device_id, polled_ts) is unique by construction. ~288 rows/day for the single device. If you create the v2 table, change tableId to mac_teltonika_rms_v2.
